name: Tsukishima Ryo
source:
2nd-year High School student. Kanade's classmate.

His flashy appearance and sociable personality are both very appealing to women. He often makes fun of Kanade's height, and making him angry is part of his daily routine.

[From [url=http://honeyapple.html.xdomain.jp/game01/chara.html]official website[/url]]
